file_name: Questionnaire - Koch - 50pct interest in certain assets of OCP Nutricrops.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Koch and OCP Nutricrops / JFC1 are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Koch and/or OCP Nutricrops/ JFC1.
